card.title: FIAT G.50
card.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card.flavorText: The Fiat G.50 Freccia (e. arrow) was an Italian fighter aircraft that was used during WWII by the Regia Aeronautica (e. Italian Royal Air force) and the Axis air forces. The aircraft was first introduced in 1938 and proved its worth in the Spanish Civil War. The early Fiat G.50s were used as interceptors in the Battle of Britain but they turned out to be too slow and short ranged. Later variants performed better and the Fiat G.50 was the most common fighter used by the Axis during the Italian Campaign, but it was still inferior to Allied fighters such as the Hawker Hurricane. From 1935 to 1943 683 Fiat G.50s had been produced, including a few variants,  but by the time the Italians surrendered in 1943 very few of them were still in service.
